hoistOptions.name: two-triangle Gram terms
hoistOptions.proposedFlatPayload: 4 float32 values per triangle (dot00,dot01,dot11,invDenom) = 8 floats/32 bytes per vertex output; fragment still computes v0/v1 for dot02/dot12 unless more vectors are carried
hoistOptions.tradeoff: Moves three dot3 products and denominator reciprocal per triangle from each fragment path to vertex work repeated per vertex invocation. G01 indexed mode presents eight distinct corner values rather than 36 submitted vertices, but hardware vertex-cache behavior and actual extra varying/register cost are unmeasured.

hoistOptions.name: UV-wrap distance u
hoistOptions.proposedFlatPayload: one float32/4 bytes per vertex output; compute only under the original vUVWrapDist>0 condition
hoistOptions.tradeoff: Moves midpoint distance (including square root) and divide out of the fragment path for wrapping decals, but adds vertex work and a flat varying; captured wrap-positive prevalence is unknown.
